A '''power scanner''' was an engineering tool that detected surges and leaks in power lines. The scanner used an invisible beam to detect variations; the beam reflected back into the scanner where a [[Microprocessor/Legends|microprocessor]] interpreted the information. The scanner could not penetrate shielded circuitry. Power scanners cost 150 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy, and were readily available for purchase throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWS" />
